cards.name: Advanced
cards.summary: Tools-panel layout 'Advanced' (Window > Toolbars > Advanced): the full toolset, 91 tools in 30 groups, in the order Select, Direct Select, Magic Wand, Lasso, the Pen family, Curvature, the Type family, Line and grid tools, shape tools, Brush and Blob Brush, Shaper and Freehand, Eraser, Scissors and Knife, Rotate and Reflect, Scale, Shear and Reshape, Width and the Warp family (Warp, Twirl, Pucker, Bloat, Scallop, Crystallize, Wrinkle), Free Transform and Puppet Warp, Shape Builder, Planar Paintbucket and Planar Face Select, the Perspective Grid tools, Mesh, Gradient, Dimension, Eyedropper, Blend, the eight Symbolism tools, the nine graph tools, Crop, Slice, Scroll, Rotate Canvas, Page, Constraints and Zoom. The preset file itself calls this layout 'Default'; it was matched to the menu label 'Advanced' by elimination (the only menu label with no preset of its own name), so the label is inferred. Not visual: no thumbnail.
use_for: day-to-day professional work that needs warp, graph, symbol, slice or perspective tools
a workspace for experienced users who do not want to customise the panel
returning to the complete toolset after using Basic or Getting Started
avoid: learning the program or a tidy panel: 91 tools in 30 slots is crowded; use Basic (37) or Getting Started (34)
assuming the label is certain: 'Advanced' was matched to the preset named 'Default' by elimination, not read directly; check the panel after switching
cards.applies_to: the Tools panel of the Illustrator window; it is a panel layout, not artwork, so no document is needed and it changes which tools are shown, never the artwork
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: Window > Toolbars > Advanced. Script: no loader call was harvested (invoke holds only the preset file <Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Presets/en_US/Tools/Tools Panel Presets), so switch the layout from the menu.

verified.note: Not visual (tools-panel layout): checked against the harvested group list, 30 groups and 91 tools in the stated order; the label "Advanced" is matched by elimination from a preset the file calls "Default", as the card says.

a baseline to duplicate into a custom flattener preset (Edit > Transparency Flattener Presets... > New)

cards.name: Width Profile 1
cards.summary: Stroke width profile 'Width Profile 1' (Stroke panel > Profile): a symmetric lens or spindle: a point at each end swelling smoothly to full width at the midpoint (widths 0, 1, 0 at 0, 50 and 100 percent of the path). (Thumbnail: not Illustrator drawing a stroke; a script draws the profile's outline as a 280 pt stroke from its Distances/Widths values, black on a pale grey plate with the path as a thin blue line, because variable width is not exposed to scripting. The path runs left to right.)
use_for: calligraphic flourishes and tapered logo lines
brush-like swooshes pointed at both ends
avoid: a stroke that needs a blunt, square end: both ends come to a point
very short paths: the whole profile is squeezed into the path length and its details disappear
evenly weighted line art: use the Uniform profile (the default) for a constant stroke
cards.applies_to: an open or closed path with a stroke: the profile varies the stroke weight along the path (the Stroke weight sets the widest point); the fill is not affected; the profile is stretched over the whole path length
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: select a stroked path, then open Window > Stroke and choose 'Width Profile 1' in the Profile menu (the Flip Along button beside it reverses the direction). Script: none; variable width is not exposed to the scripting DOM and no call was harvested (the profiles live in <Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Support Files/Required/Resources/en_US/VariableWidthProfiles).

verified.note: Script drawing, not an Illustrator stroke: black symmetric lens on the grey plate, pointed at both ends, widest at mid-path; matches the file values widths 0, 1, 0.

cards.name: Width Profile 2
cards.summary: Stroke width profile 'Width Profile 2' (Stroke panel > Profile): a wavy ribbon: it starts narrow, swells to near full width a fifth of the way along, pinches to about a third of that width at 40 percent, swells again at 60 to 80 percent and drops to a narrow tip at the end. (Thumbnail: not Illustrator drawing a stroke; a script draws the profile's outline as a 280 pt stroke from its Distances/Widths values, black on a pale grey plate with the path as a thin blue line, because variable width is not exposed to scripting. The path runs left to right.)
use_for: vine, rope-bone or hand-brushed organic lines
avoid: a clean geometric line: the bulges and pinch are conspicuous
very short paths: the whole profile is squeezed into the path length and its details disappear
evenly weighted line art: use the Uniform profile (the default) for a constant stroke
cards.applies_to: an open or closed path with a stroke: the profile varies the stroke weight along the path (the Stroke weight sets the widest point); the fill is not affected; the profile is stretched over the whole path length
cards.how_to_apply: Panel: select a stroked path, then open Window > Stroke and choose 'Width Profile 2' in the Profile menu (the Flip Along button beside it reverses the direction). Script: none; variable width is not exposed to the scripting DOM and no call was harvested (the profiles live in <Illustrator 2026 install folder>/Support Files/Required/Resources/en_US/VariableWidthProfiles).
